scope: All 34 frozen liberation 1814 cohort entries, including distinct January/February Bar-sur-Aube, February/March Soissons, two Reims entries and whole blockade/multi-day intervals.
policy: Main session only. At most three preassigned source families including Bodart, at most one targeted follow-up per entry. Bibliographic metadata only inspected before assignment; previously registered books and immutable snapshots reused. No subagents, separate review, second opinion, feature admission, calibration scoring or new outcome fit.

families.bodart-kriegs-lexikon-1908: Frozen frame compilation and registered facsimiles.
families.vaudoncourt-military-histories: French retrospective histories, France combined I/II/III première partie (1826) and Italy (1817). All works, volumes and embedded documents one family. Other national observations mediated.
families.plotho-krieg-1813-1814: Prussian officer national retrospective I–III (1817), especially III for 1814. Allied contingent reports mediated; original local returns not presumed inspected. All volumes and embedded documents one family.
